methods: Peak context from the project's own posts: distinctive terms vs. baseline (document-level log-odds), rule-based event typing, amount extraction, source/syndication profile
Targeted Google News RSS search built from the peak's distinctive terms; hits ranked by overlap with the peak's posts
Persistence analysis: decay time to baseline, post volume 7-21 days after, sentiment 14 days before/after
Public HTML metadata & headline extraction from official city/project homepages
Optional: manually curated event list (curated_events.json); optional LLM summary (USE_LLM)
collection_metadata.interpretation_note: context.summary describes the likely occasion based on the posts and external headlines; confidence high/medium/low is scored from event type, independent sources, external corroboration and topic fit — not from a fixed post count.
collection_metadata.compliance_note: Only publicly accessible pages without login or paywall were queried; no personal user identifiers collected.
